'''Rabbit Nose''' is a young, fierce [[wolf]].

==Activities==
Rabbit Nose, along with [[Two Moons]], [[Wildfire]], [[Old Deer]], [[Half Tail]], [[Morning Clouds]] and many more wolves are known to [[Perrin Aybara]]. They scout for Perrin when he is searching for [[Rand al'Thor]], who was kidnapped by [[Aes Sedai]].{{ref/book|6|54}}
